mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with perphenazine (antipsychotic) increases risk of serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and severe CNS depression through additive monoamine potentiation and dopamine/norepinephrine inhibition.
action: Avoid this combination if possible; if necessary, use with extreme caution, close monitoring of blood pressure, temperature, and mental status, and consider alternative antipsychotics with lower interaction potential.
